text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a research paper presenting a novel participatory framework applied explicitly at the national scale of Tanzania (~883,600 km²). The primary focus is on land use and land cover change (LULCC) prediction/simulation under multiple future scenarios (business as usual and green economy), with quantitative comparisons of land cover changes (e.g., cultivated land expansion, degradation) and spatially explicit outputs including national maps of LULCC likelihood. The paper includes spatial modeling steps, quantitative estimates of change rates, and scenario-based mapped projections, meeting all core inclusion criteria. It is not a review article, nor does it meet any exclusion criteria. The participatory approach integrates stakeholder-driven scenario development with quantitative spatial modeling at a national scale, with multiple scenarios compared and spatial outputs produced.)
